verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is a built-in automation engine: users write YAML workflow rules compatible with GitHub Actions and reuse existing actions. Webhooks add event-driven custom workflows. Together these cover the core of defining rules that run actions automatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the event trigger types (push, PR, issue, schedule), no hands-on or independent corroboration of event-triggered automation, and no evidence of AI-specific rule definition.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
